sources.entry: Raycast AI - Mac-native operating system AI extension. #freemium

summary.name: Raycast AI
summary.one_liner: Raycast AI is a macOS-native AI assistant built into the Raycast launcher, offering agents, quick AI prompts, AI extensions, and access to multiple LLM providers.
use_cases: Asking quick AI questions from anywhere on a Mac
Fixing grammar or adjusting tone in emails via keyboard shortcuts
Scheduling agents to handle recurring tasks like email checks or weekly updates
Using one interface to switch between multiple LLM providers
Running AI with local models through Ollama for privacy
Sharing custom AI extensions within a team
summary.what_it_does: Raycast AI adds AI agents to the Raycast Mac app. Agents can have project-specific instructions, memory, and their own models, and can use context from the screen. Quick AI handles small tasks from any app, and AI Commands turn saved prompts into keyboard shortcuts. AI Extensions connect everyday tools so the AI can act in them. The page says it supports all major LLM provider subscriptions and local models, and that user data is stored locally with optional encrypted Cloud Sync for chats.
notable: Runs inside the Raycast Mac launcher with screen-aware context and scheduled agents
Works with multiple LLM providers through one interface, including Ollama local models
Can use existing Claude or ChatGPT subscriptions or your own API keys
Data stored locally; AI providers contractually barred from training on interactions
caveats: Requires macOS Tahoe and Apple Silicon
AI usage is metered by monthly AI Credits (500 on Pro, 500 per user on Teams Pro); usage varies by model and agent activity
Paid plans: Pro at $8/month ($96 billed annually), Teams Pro at $12/user/month; Enterprise pricing is custom
